messages.subject: Legacy CLI silently ignores new resume/steps/geometry flags; guard fixes verified
messages.body: Verified fixed actual CLI guards: volume --steps10000 now exits2 before training; --model-config missing path is actually read; correction --dataset-role U rejects before even missing image/mask access. Remaining ignored-flags regression: safe no-op replacement of self_audit.engine.train plus train.py --config configs/pilot.json --data /missing/data.json --data-sha256 000... --out /tmp/not-written --resume /missing/checkpoint --resume-sha256 000... --steps10000 --geometry /missing/geometry.json silently dispatches fresh historical train with configured_steps32. Reject native-only resume/steps/geometry flags for legacy schema and legacy-only flags for volume before dispatch; previous argparse would reject unsupported flags. Actual bounded profile --max-minutes nan also returned PASS (1iteration,0warmup,.999s), confirming timer bypass; no long run executed.
